name: Knitwear
description: T-shirts, polos, fleece, sweatshirts and loungewear. Cotton, cotton-poly, French terry and rib from approved mills — a custom t-shirt factory Vietnam brands use as a bulk polo shirt manufacturer for retail programmes.

name: Woven
description: Shirts, blouses, dresses, chinos and shorts in poplin, twill, linen blends and viscose. A woven pants supplier Vietnam teams use for both direct-to-consumer and department-store programmes.

name: Outerwear
description: Padded jackets, wool and felt coats, vests. Down and synthetic fill with DWR finishes — a waterproof jacket manufacturer working in taped-seam construction.

name: Kidswear
description: Full range for 2–14 years, produced to CPSIA and EN 14682 drawstring requirements. Knit dress manufacturer for kids programmes and school uniform runs.

name: Protective & workwear
description: Hi-vis, coveralls and uniform programs with reinforced construction. FOB sportswear manufacturer Vietnam with AQL inspection on every run.

name: Accessories
description: Socks, underwear and basics through certified partner mills, sourced alongside the main garment package.
